source_row.rationale: Procalcitonin tends to be more specifically elevated in bacterial infections (and less so in viral infections), making it a useful biomarker to help support the diagnosis of bacterial infection/sepsis and guide decisions about initiating, continuing, or discontinuing antibiotic therapy, used alongside overall clinical assessment rather than as a standalone diagnostic tool.
